name: rotary_embedding
description: Adjacent-pair rotary embedding. For x [tokens, heads, head_size] and cos/sin [tokens, head_size//2], interpret each head vector as pairs (x1,x2) and compute o1 = x1*cos - x2*sin, o2 = x1*sin + x2*cos in float32, then cast back to x.dtype. cos/sin are indexed only by the first head_size//2 frequencies. Returns a newly allocated [tokens, heads, head_size] tensor and does not mutate inputs. The public interleaved argument is accepted for API compatibility but is not inspected by the native kernel; the implemented layout is always the adjacent-pair form. Suites exercise bfloat16 x/cos/sin with interleaved=False.
